policies.title: A sudoers rule grants all commands without a password
policies.description: Checks that no rule combines NOPASSWD with the command ALL.
policies.rationale: Passwordless full root removes the re-authentication barrier after any account compromise.
policies.absence_note: No such rule means nothing to flag.
policies.remediation: Require a password, or list only the specific commands that need NOPASSWD.

policies.title: A sudoers rule applies to every user
policies.description: Checks that no rule has ALL as its user.
policies.rationale: A rule for ALL users hands the granted rights to every account on the system.
policies.absence_note: No rule lines means nothing to flag.
policies.remediation: Name the users or groups that need the rights.

policies.title: sudo authentication is switched off with !authenticate
policies.description: Checks that Defaults !authenticate is not used.
policies.rationale: It disables the password prompt for the scope it covers.

policies.title: sudo does not reset the environment
policies.description: Checks that Defaults !env_reset is not used.
policies.rationale: Inherited variables such as LD_PRELOAD can subvert a privileged command.
policies.absence_note: env_reset is on by default in modern sudo (UNVERIFIED).

policies.title: sudo does not run commands in a pseudo-terminal
policies.description: Checks that Defaults use_pty is set.
policies.rationale: A pty prevents a background process from injecting input into the terminal after sudo exits.
policies.absence_note: The default is not guaranteed to be on across versions (UNVERIFIED): treated as a failure.

policies.title: sudo credential cache lasts long or forever
policies.description: Checks that timestamp_timeout is between 0 and 15 minutes.
policies.rationale: A long cache lets any process of the user run sudo unprompted.
policies.absence_note: Default is a few minutes (5 per my recollection, UNVERIFIED), within the 15-minute bound used here.

policies.title: sudo keeps dangerous environment variables
policies.description: Checks that env_keep does not preserve loader or interpreter search variables.
policies.rationale: Those variables let the caller inject code into a root process.

policies.title: sudo asks for the target or root password
policies.description: Checks that targetpw, rootpw and runaspw are not enabled.
policies.rationale: Sharing the root password defeats per-user accountability.
policies.absence_note: Default asks for the invoking user's password.

policies.title: NOPASSWD is granted for a shell, editor or interpreter
policies.description: Checks that passwordless commands are not programs that can spawn a shell (a public GTFOBins-style concept).
policies.rationale: Such a command is a root shell in disguise.
policies.remediation: Grant narrowly scoped, non-interactive commands, or require a password.

policies.title: A sudoers command contains a wildcard
policies.description: Checks that granted commands are not wildcarded.
policies.rationale: Wildcards in arguments can be widened by the caller to run unintended things.
policies.remediation: Spell out exact commands and arguments.
